verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic control of Teams. You can create teams, add people, configure channels, tabs and apps, post channel messages, automate conversations and export chats, which covers a substantial share of core UI actions. Nothing in the pack claims or demonstrates UI-to-API parity, and many UI surfaces are not shown to be API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit parity claim or coverage map, API evidence for meetings, calling, files, settings and notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
